technical_and_design_decisions: Extend the Flo stream DSL parser and AST model to accept global configuration properties for 'timeout' and 'pollInterval' with fallback to system defaults.
Upgrade Spring Integration dependency version across all sub-projects to 4.2.1 Release, addressing deprecations or API changes in Spring Integration components.
Refactor JobLaunchingTasklet by optimizing job launching context instantiation, reducing synchronous metadata queries, and caching Spring Batch job parameters.
Extend stream definition parsing logic to evaluate inline SpEL expressions uniformly across OOTB and custom stream modules before payload delivery.
Introduce an 'UNDEPLOYED' state in the Spring YARN SPI Application/Container status enums and update state machine mappings across YARN deployer components.
Split the monolithic admin module into distro-neutral core modules and dedicated distro-specific sub-modules (e.g., Cloudera, Hortonworks) using Maven/Gradle dependency isolation.
assumptions: Development work will be performed by a single developer familiar with Java 17+, Spring Framework, Spring Integration, Spring Batch, Spring Cloud Data Flow / Flo DSL, and YARN SPIs.
Existing automated build pipelines and test suites are available and functional.
No breaking API changes exist in Spring Integration 4.2.1 that would require complete redesign of custom adapters.
Job Orchestration documentation will be written in Markdown/AsciiDoc format integrated with standard Spring project documentation structures.

activities.activity_description: Update the Flo DSL grammar, AST, and parser to support global 'timeout' and 'pollInterval' options, including default fallback logic and unit tests.
Update project dependency management to Spring Integration 4.2.1, fix compilation errors, resolve deprecated API calls, and verify core messaging flows.
Analyze performance bottlenecks in JobLaunchingTasklet, optimize job execution initialization, refactor state management, and add performance micro-benchmarks.

activities.activity_name: DSL and XML Generation Test Coverage (U4)
activities.activity_description: Design and implement comprehensive parameterized unit and integration tests covering various DSL to XML transformation variants and edge cases.

activities.activity_name: Inline SpEL Expression Support in Stream Definitions (U5)
activities.activity_description: Enhance stream definition parsing and runtime evaluation context to support inline SpEL expressions across standard and custom modules.
Draft comprehensive user guidelines, batch workflow pattern examples, and architecture documentation for job orchestration.
Update YARN SPI status enums, deployer state handlers, and status queries to distinguish between 'UNDEPLOYED' and 'UNKNOWN' states.
Modularize the 'admin' module into core and distribution-specific library packaging artifacts to decouple Hadoop vendor dependencies.
Run full regression test suite, verify multi-module builds, validate packaging artifacts, and ensure clean CI build completion.
